annotations.title: Give up the weather word puzzle

description: Use this only when the player asks to give up on the daily word puzzle in Weather With Attitude. Ends the game as a loss and returns the answer, the board and a spoiler-free share grid. Send the puzzle number and every guess made so far.

conversation_id.description: Set by the Words card so its moves count in the same anonymous usage stats as the chat. Leave it out.

previous_guesses.description: Every earlier guess in this game, oldest first. Empty or omitted before the first guess.

puzzle_number.description: The puzzle number returned by start_daily_puzzle.

time_zone.description: The player's IANA time zone, for example "Europe/London" or "America/New_York". Picks the puzzle for their local date. Omit if unknown.

utc_offset_minutes.description: The player's UTC offset in minutes (60 for UTC+1, -300 for UTC-5), used only when the time zone is unknown. Omit both to use UTC.

name: weather_word_puzzle_give_up
